name: frame-arcade-js
description: Classic arcade games as Frame state machines, rendered with Phaser, with a live state chart beside the gameplay.

scripts.test:cca: npm run gen && esbuild --bundle src/cca/cca.e2e.test.ts --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=node_modules/.cache/cca-e2e.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/cca-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:cca:suite: npm run gen && esbuild --bundle src/cca/tests/run.ts --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=node_modules/.cache/cca-suite.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/cca-suite.mjs
scripts.test:cca:slow: npm run gen && esbuild --bundle src/cca/tests/run_slow.ts --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=node_modules/.cache/cca-slow.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/cca-slow.mjs
